title: Peace of mind from the first tap.

cards.title: Super secure
cards.body: Sign in with a one-time code via WhatsApp or email, and your data is always encrypted.

cards.title: Global payment methods
cards.body: Pay with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or directly from your bank account.

cards.title: We never store your card details
cards.body: Your card number is never saved with us, and every payment is protected and encrypted.

cards.title: Your privacy, protected
cards.body: GDPR-compliant — the EU’s data protection standard.
